verdict.rationale: Lium's docs say the platform API publishes a live OpenAPI 3.1 schema, and they give a concrete download URL (https://lium.io/api/openapi.json) used in an openapi-typescript codegen example. The probe 404s were only on docs.lium.io paths, not the documented lium.io/api/openapi.json, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the documented lium.io/api/openapi.json URL actually resolves and serves the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The Lium platform API publishes a live [OpenAPI 3.1](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.0) schema.
